messages:
janelle: FYI BrightCart (INC-2026-321) reporting webhooks failing since ~08:23 UTC after our egress reshuffle. They say they've allowlisted our IPs but we're getting 403 / connection resets.

miriam: Can repro from our side — curl to their webhook endpoint gets TLS handshake then ECONNRESET.

miriam: curl -v -X POST https://hooks.brightcart.com/order -d '{\"id\":123}' -H 'Content-Type: application/json'  --> output:
```
* Connected to hooks.brightcart.com (52.23.10.101) port 443 (#0)
* TLS handshake: Received EOF
* Connection reset by peer
```

janelle: From support logs, their firewall shows DROPPED SYNs originating from 3.17.45.22 (our new SNAT). They had only whitelisted 3.17.40.11 and 3.17.40.12.

luca: We ran egress-rebalance at 08:20 to even AZ load; SNAT assignments rotated for many subnets. I know we didn't flag customers with tight allowlists — point taken.

luca: New egress addresses serving BrightCart's VPC (post-rebalance):
```
3.17.45.22
3.17.45.23
3.17.45.24
```

janelle: Customer initially said they whitelist hostnames (hooks.brightcart.com) rather than IPs, but their firewall resolves once and caches the IP. Their DNS cache had the old mapping for 300s TTL.

miriam: We also observed the A record flip — dig from our egress host before/after:
```
# before
hooks.brightcart.com. 300 IN A 3.17.40.11
# after
hooks.brightcart.com. 60 IN A 3.17.45.22
```

miriam: Their firewall's cached resolution + our SNAT rotation created a window where packets came from an unallowed IP.

sahil: Short-term workaround: requested customer add the whole egress pool CIDR 3.17.45.0/24 to their allowlist. They applied it and webhooks resumed at 08:32 UTC :white_check_mark:.

sahil: Follow-ups (internal):
- notify customers with narrow allowlists before any egress reassignments
- add an opt-in static egress (reserved SNAT) per-customer for critical webhooks
- create an alert when we see repeated 403s/REJECTs correlated with recent egress reassigns

infra-bot: egress-rebalance job run: egress-rebalance/2026-03-17T08:20Z — rotated 17 SNATs in us-east-1

luca: I'll open a doc + PR to add pre-notify and an exemption flag so we don't rotate pinned egress addresses. Also investigating why the notify pipeline didn't mark this customer.

janelle: Ticket updated and closing after customer confirmation. Marking incident resolved.
